author: osuthers
quote: best game ever. makes me miss the original all too much. love all the heroic themes.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: osuthers
quote: 13 years of dev time, and it turns out they just burnt all that time adding the most pointless mechanics of "realism" but at the expense of removing features that people actually enjoyed. anyone who uses games for "realism" and not the escapism it was designed for, is doing it wrong.
